ideal_relations.formula: Pi_{i, a} Pi_{i, b} = 0 for a != b
Tr(Pi_{i, a} Pi_{j, b}) = 1/6 for i != j

soundness_gap_formulation.definition: The mathematical discrepancy between truncated pseudo-expectation feasibility and true physical projector realization on pre-Hilbert space H.

required_closure_bridges.description: Algebraic certificate in the quadratic module certifying Archimedean operator norm boundedness (R^2 - sum Pi^2 in Q(T)).
required_closure_bridges.guarantee: Convergence of the non-commutative moment-SOS hierarchy to the physical operator state cone.

required_closure_bridges.description: Condition rank(M_d) = rank(M_{d-1}) on the certified moment matrix.
required_closure_bridges.guarantee: Curto-Fialkow flat extension theorem and GNS construction guarantee exact finite-dimensional projector realization extraction.

open_proof_obligations.statement: Construct an explicit exact rational Archimedean Positivstellensatz identity bounding the non-commutative projector quadratic module.
Evaluate rank-loop closure conditions rank(M_4) = rank(M_3) or prove algebraic obstruction to flat extension.
